title: Beetle Sorcerer Ritual
description: A large anthropomorphic beetle wearing a golden crown and ornate robe stands behind an altar covered in black soil. The beetle holds a magical ring while casting a spell, surrounded by floating golden rings, glowing orbs, lit candles, an open book, and smaller beetles arranged in a mystical circle.
